app.title: ExamForge
app.subtitle: Arabic Exam Composer
app.description: Professional open-source platform for school teachers to compose and print exam papers in Arabic with advanced math, physics, and chemistry notation.

subscription.redeemDesc: Enter your 12-character activation code issued by administrator to unlock pro features.
subscription.benefit1: Complete removal of watermark from all exports
subscription.benefit2: Word export (.docx) with mathematical notation preserved
subscription.benefit3: A/B version generation with shuffled questions
subscription.benefit4: Automated bubble sheets and answer keys
subscription.benefit5: Cloud question bank and AI assistant

phase0.statusBanner: Phase 0: Core foundation built, offline-ready with encrypted Supabase backend
phase0.feat1: Native Arabic first UI with complete RTL support
phase0.feat2: Secure local client storage via IndexedDB (Dexie)
phase0.feat3: Dark and Light themes with persistent preference
phase0.feat4: Secure Supabase backend (Strict RLS & SHA-256 hashed codes)
phase0.feat5: PWA support for offline school desktop use
